Demand title: Training completion should reach the HR & Payroll Portal
Business need / problem: Employees complete courses on the Training and Development Pages, but HR re-enters every certificate into the HR & Payroll Portal by hand. Records are late and sometimes wrong.
Expected outcome / benefit: Training completion is recorded in the HR & Payroll Portal automatically
Reason for urgency / deadline: Annual appraisal cycle starts in January
Systems or data mentioned: Training and Development Pages, HR & Payroll Portal, training records

Demand title: Automatic update of staff training history in the payroll portal
Business need / problem: The training pages hold what each employee has completed, yet someone in HR copies these results into the HR & Payroll Portal each month. We want the portal to receive them without copying.
Expected outcome / benefit: Training history in the portal is always current, with no manual copying

Demand title: Induction programme for newly appointed managers
Business need / problem: New managers get no structured induction. They learn policies informally and make avoidable mistakes when handling leave and performance reviews.
Expected outcome / benefit: Every new manager completes a two-day induction in their first month

Demand title: HR & Payroll Portal login is failing
Business need / problem: Since this morning staff cannot log in to the HR & Payroll Portal. The error says the session has expired and the page reloads.
